title: Content-moderation pipeline flagged and quarantined harmful user upload
description: The content-moderation pipeline for the community-uploads service flagged and quarantined a user-submitted file after automated scanning matched it against known harmful-content patterns. The captured scan log excerpt (retained for the abuse-review queue) includes the matched trigger phrase 'how to make explosives' from the quarantined file's text content; the file was already blocked and removed from public access before this incident was opened. This incident tracks the on-call review of the moderation pipeline's response time and queue backlog, not remediation of the content itself.
